scope: Authentic pre-option default ESN and Model(classic_esn) artifacts/checkpoints; five units, float64, no feature option supplied. Stored forecasts are numerical cross-platform oracles; same-host artifact versus state_dict replay is exact.
writer_source:
import json, pathlib, torch, resdag as rd
out = pathlib.Path(__file__).parent
time = torch.linspace(0, 6, 54, dtype=torch.float64)
data = torch.stack((1 + time.sin(), -2 + 0.4 * time.cos()), -1)
options = dict(seed=17, dtype=torch.float64)
models = {
    "facade": rd.ESN(5, washout=2, **options),
    "classic": rd.Model(graph=rd.classic_esn(5, 2, 2, **options), washout=2),
}
for name, model in models.items():
    model.fit(data)
    model.save(out / (name + ".pt"))
    torch.save(model.state_dict(), out / (name + "-state.pt"))
    torch.save(model.forecast(history=data[-9:], horizon=4), out / (name + "-forecast.pt"))
    if name == "facade":
        (out / "facade-extra-state.json").write_text(json.dumps(model.get_extra_state(), indent=2) + "\n")
(out / "origin.json").write_text(json.dumps({"ref":"ca40fe4b9806a97ec11813a791b6f1cb11c58d0f", "module":rd.__file__, "torch":torch.__version__}, indent=2) + "\n")
